caveat: This is a source inventory for app readiness. It records official or candidate source locations and collection status; it is not a normalized row-level audit, CVR, or incident dataset.

audit.sourceTitle: Wisconsin Elections Commission post-election voting equipment audit information
audit.nextAction: Use a browser or manual review because elections.wi.gov blocks scripted collection with Cloudflare. Normalize the 2024 audit selection/results fields when the official artifact is accessible.

cvr.sourceTitle: Wisconsin county cast vote record availability inventory
cvr.nextAction: Confirm county-by-county CVR availability or public-record request path. Current artifact is a 72-county inventory scaffold, not a loaded CVR dataset.

incidents.sourceTitle: Wisconsin Elections Commission 2024 general election and public meeting materials
incidents.nextAction: Inventory official incident, correction, recount, and litigation records from WEC and county sources; normalize source-linked rows when found.
